_README: Hand-written labelled set for the Fast small-talk lane (app/fast_lane.py). Derived from the 2026-09-14 map-quality-guard set (190 self-written items) and re-labelled for this round: every acknowledgement is FULL_PATH (category ack_full_path_this_round), pleasantries outside the closed lexicon are FULL_PATH (not_in_lexicon_this_round), and near-misses were added (x###). FAST_LANE items carry `lane_category`, the category the lane must report. No production messages.
